title: Affine spectrum stalk-ring and input-complex coordinates
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$, $g:S'\to S$ and $g':X'\to X$ form a cartesian square of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], and assume the spectrum maps on global sections also form a cartesian square. Fix the sheaf derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], a complex $P$ of modules on $X$, and $z_0\in\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(X',\top)$. Put $z=X'.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}(z_0)$ and $P_0=(X.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1})^*P$ termwise. Define $R,A,B,D$ and $R_0,A_0,B_0,D_0$ as the four stalk rings of the two squares, with their actual stalk-map algebra structures, and $\mu:A\otimes_R B\to D$, $\mu_0:A_0\otimes_{R_0}B_0\to D_0$ as their tensorMap homomorphisms [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Let $Q=P_{g'(z)}$ and $Q_0=(P_0)_{(\operatorname{Spec}(g'^\sharp))(z_0)}$ be stalk complexes. There exist ring equivalences $e_R:R\cong R_0$, $e_A:A\cong A_0$, $e_B:B\cong B_0$, $e_D:D\cong D_0$ and a chain isomorphism $q:Q\cong\operatorname{Res}_{e_A}Q_0$ [lem-pc-iso-pullback-stalk-cohomology] such that, for every $r\in R$, $e_A(r_A)=e_R(r)_{A_0}$ and $e_B(r_B)=e_R(r)_{B_0}$, and for every $a\in A$, $b\in B$, $e_D(\mu(a\otimes b))=\mu_0(e_A(a)\otimes e_B(b))$. No tensor-complex isomorphism or homology compatibility is asserted.

source.place: sheaves.tex, lemma-stalk-pullback-modules; Tag 0096 pullback adjunction; affine-spectrum naturality

proof.text: Construct each ring equivalence as the point equality isomorphism followed by the invertible stalk map of the inverse isoSpec map. Obtain hA and hB by evaluating isoSpec_inv_naturality for g' and f', and obtain hR by composing hA with isoSpec_inv_naturality for f. For any affine morphism, stalkMap_congr_hom applied to isoSpec_inv_naturality and stalkMap_comp proves the naturality equation for these equivalences. Equality induction identifies stalkCongr with eqToHom. Apply this equation to f for R-to-A compatibility. For R-to-B, first transport the base point using sq.w and sq0.w, then apply naturality for g. Equality induction on these two point equalities gives compatibility of the ring equivalences with the two stalkCongr maps.

The two restriction equations in exists_tensorMap imply that tensorMap sends a pure tensor to the product of its g' and f' projection images: write the tensor as algebraMap(a) times includeRight(b), then use map_mul and both equations. Apply the preceding stalk naturality equation to g' and f'. Since eD preserves multiplication, these two equations give the claimed pure-tensor compatibility.

Apply exists_tensorPullback_stalk_iso to j=X.isoSpec.inv at g0'(z0), obtaining T naturally isomorphic to S followed by extension along rho=j.stalkMap. Since rho is invertible, restrictScalars rho is an equivalence (ModuleCat.restrictScalars_isEquivalence_of_ringEquiv). The extension/restriction adjunction therefore makes extension an equivalence too and its unit is invertible. Whisker the unit with S and follow it by the inverse tensor-pullback-stalk isomorphism whiskered with restriction. This gives S naturally isomorphic to T followed by restriction of scalars. Use the auxiliary comparisonStalkAdditive instance from the source-transport module and tensorPullbackAdditive from the stalk-condition module to map this natural isomorphism to complexes. Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso identifies the compositions with the stated termwise complexes. Equality induction on hA gives the comparison at the requested old point and identifies rho with eA.toRingHom. Combine this chain isomorphism with the four ring equivalences and the three compatibility equations.

theorem exists_affineSpectrum_stalk_coordinate_data
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    (sq0 : IsPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop))
    (z0 : Spec Γ(X', ⊤))
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let z := X'.isoSpec.inv z0
    let P0 := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj P
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (R f g' z))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (B f' z))
    letI := leftAlgebra (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0
    letI := rightAlgebra (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0
    letI := (tensorMap (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} (R (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (B (Spec.map f'.appTop) z0))
    let R0 := R (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0
    let A0 := A (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0
    let B0 := B (Spec.map f'.appTop) z0
    let D0 := C z0
    let Q := stalkComplex g' z P
    let Q0 := stalkComplex (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0 P0
    ∃ (eR : R f g' z ≃+* R0) (eA : A g' z ≃+* A0)
      (eB : B f' z ≃+* B0) (eD : C z ≃+* D0)
      (q : Q ≅ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} eA.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj Q0),
      (∀ r : R f g' z,
        eA (algebraMap (R f g' z) (A g' z) r) = algebraMap R0 A0 (eR r)) ∧
      (∀ r : R f g' z,
        eB (algebraMap (R f g' z) (B f' z) r) = algebraMap R0 B0 (eR r)) ∧
      (∀ (a : A g' z) (b : B f' z),
        eD (algebraMap (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z) (C z) (a ⊗ₜ[R f g' z] b)) =
          algebraMap (A0 ⊗[R0] B0) D0 (eA a ⊗ₜ[R0] eB b))
